query:
SELECT 
  searchId,
  COUNT(*) as total_companies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN briefData IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN briefData LIKE '%urgencySignals%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_signals
FROM companies 
WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003)
GROUP BY searchId;
